The core REST API for the Ninetailed (now Contentful Personalization) platform. Returns visitor profiles and resolves which experience and variant to render based on audience rules. Deployed on the edge for high performance. Supports profile creation, updates, retrieval, deletion, event tracking, and batch event import for audience segmentation and A/B test delivery.
